h4-anzhao.ch: __调查，很多年轻人每天上网三个小时。
h4-anzhao.en: According to a survey, many young people spend three hours a day online.
h4-anzhao.why: A survey is information you draw a conclusion from, so it takes 根据, not 按照.

h4-anzhao.en: Please hand in your homework by the set time, everyone.
h4-anzhao.why: 按照 + the rule you follow comes before the action.

h4-anzhao.ch: 按照新闻，那里昨天下了大雪。
h4-anzhao.fix: 根据新闻，那里昨天下了大雪。
h4-anzhao.en: According to the news, it snowed heavily there yesterday.
h4-anzhao.why: The news is information, not a plan you follow, so use 根据.

h4-anzhao.ch: 他每天按照计划学习两个小时。
h4-anzhao.en: He studies for two hours a day, sticking to his plan.
h4-anzhao.why: A plan you follow takes 按照.

h4-anzhao.en: Please finish your homework the way the teacher asked, everyone.
h4-anzhao.why: 按照 goes right before the rule you follow; the action comes after it.

h4-ba-jiaozuo.ch: 大家__这个小公园叫作“猫公园”，因为那里有很多猫。
h4-ba-jiaozuo.en: Everyone calls this little park "Cat Park", because there are lots of cats there.
h4-ba-jiaozuo.why: The thing being named goes after 把, then 叫作 + the name.
把 + the one being named, then 叫作 + the name.

h4-ba-jiaozuo.fix: 同学们把她叫作“小老师”。
h4-ba-jiaozuo.why: The person being named goes after 把, before 叫作.

h4-ba-jiaozuo.ch: 他总是很开心，被大家叫作“小太阳”。
h4-ba-jiaozuo.en: He's always cheerful, so everyone calls him "Little Sunshine".
h4-ba-jiaozuo.why: With 被, the one being named comes first and 叫作 + the name follows.
叫作 comes after 把 + the thing, right before its name.

h4-bei.ch: 今年的学生是去年的两__。
h4-bei.en: There are twice as many students this year as last year.
h4-bei.why: 倍 means "times as much"; 次 counts how often something happens.

h4-bei.en: Things in this shop cost twice as much as in that one.
h4-bei.why: With 比, the number + 倍 goes after the adjective.

h4-bei.ch: 今年来旅游的人比去年少了一倍。
h4-bei.fix: 今年来旅游的人比去年少了一半。
h4-bei.en: Half as many tourists came this year as last year.
h4-bei.why: 倍 is only for going up; for less, use 一半.

h4-bei.ch: 这个房间的价格是那个房间的两倍。
h4-bei.en: This room costs twice as much as that one.
h4-bei.why: A 是 B 的 + number + 倍 is the clearest way to say it.

h4-bei.en: He runs twice as fast as me.
h4-bei.why: 倍 comes last: A 是 B 的 + number + 倍.

h4-benlai.ch: 我__打算周末去爬山，可是下雨了。
h4-benlai.en: I'd planned to go hiking at the weekend, but it rained.
h4-benlai.why: 本来 says what the plan was before something changed.

h4-benlai.en: I was going to fly there, but the tickets had sold out.
h4-benlai.why: 本来 comes before the verb, and the next part tells you what changed.

h4-benlai.en: Oh, it's you! Come on in.
h4-benlai.why: On recognising someone, say 原来 ("so that's who it is"); 本来 can't mean that.

h4-benlai.ch: 他本来就很瘦，最近又瘦了。
h4-benlai.en: He was thin to begin with, and he's got even thinner lately.
h4-benlai.why: 本来就 means it was already so from the start.

h4-benlai.en: I'd planned to rest at the weekend, but the manager made me work overtime.
h4-benlai.why: 本来 goes after the subject, before the plan that then changed.

h4-bing.ch: 你以为他生气了？其实他__没有生气。
h4-bing.en: You thought he was angry? Actually, he wasn't angry at all.
h4-bing.why: 并 before 没有 pushes back against what someone thinks; 并且 and 而且 join clauses.

h4-bing.en: He doesn't actually like his current job.
h4-bing.why: 并 goes right before 不 to correct what people might think.

h4-bing.en: "Do you eat spicy food?" "No, I don't."
h4-bing.why: A plain answer just takes 不; 并不 is for correcting an expectation.

h4-bing.ch: 别看他个子小，他的力气并不小。
h4-bing.en: He may be small, but he's actually quite strong.
h4-bing.why: 并不 corrects what you'd expect from his size.

h4-bing.en: I never actually agreed to this plan.
h4-bing.why: 并 goes right before 没有 to push back against what someone believes.

h4-bingqie.ch: 他会说汉语，__说得非常好。
h4-bingqie.en: He speaks Chinese, and speaks it really well.
h4-bingqie.why: 和 and 跟 only join nouns; 并且 joins two actions or clauses.

h4-bingqie.en: He completed the task and was praised by the manager.
h4-bingqie.why: 并且 starts the second action, after the comma.

h4-bingqie.ch: 她打扫了房间和洗了衣服。
h4-bingqie.fix: 她打扫了房间，并且洗了衣服。
h4-bingqie.en: She cleaned the room and did the washing.
h4-bingqie.why: 和 can't join two actions; use 并且.

h4-bingqie.ch: 请大家认真复习，并且按时参加考试。
h4-bingqie.en: Please revise carefully, everyone, and come to the exam on time.
h4-bingqie.why: 并且 adds a further step to the first action.

h4-bingqie.en: This shop is cheap, and it's close to my home too.
h4-bingqie.why: 并且 opens the second clause, right after the comma.

h4-biru.ch: 他有很多爱好，__唱歌、跳舞、游泳。
h4-biru.en: He has lots of hobbies — singing, dancing and swimming, for example.
h4-biru.why: 比如 brings in examples after the general idea.

h4-biru.en: I like fruit — apples and watermelon, for example.
h4-biru.why: The general idea comes first, then 比如 and the examples.

h4-biru.ch: 比如包子、饺子，我会做很多中国菜。
h4-biru.fix: 我会做很多中国菜，比如包子、饺子。
h4-biru.en: I can cook lots of Chinese dishes, such as buns and dumplings.
h4-biru.why: Say the general idea first; 比如 and the examples come after.

h4-biru.ch: 这里有很多好玩的地方，比如说那个老公园。
h4-biru.en: There are lots of fun places here — that old park, for instance.
h4-biru.why: 比如说 is the chattier version of 比如, still after the general idea.

h4-biru.en: There's lots to do at weekends, like reading, hiking or swimming.
h4-biru.why: 比如 comes after the general idea, right before the examples.

h4-buguan.ch: __工作多忙，他每天都给妈妈打电话。
h4-buguan.en: However busy work is, he calls his mum every day.
h4-buguan.why: 多忙 is an open question, so it needs 不管; 尽管 and 虽然 take a plain fact.

h4-buguan.en: Whatever you say, I'm not going.
h4-buguan.why: 不管 + an open question, then 都 in the second half.

h4-buguan.ch: 不管天气很热，他都去打篮球。
h4-buguan.fix: 不管天气多热，他都去打篮球。
h4-buguan.en: However hot it is, he still goes to play basketball.
h4-buguan.why: 不管 needs an open question like 多热, not a statement like 很热.

h4-buguan.ch: 不管是大人还是孩子，都喜欢吃这种蛋糕。
h4-buguan.en: Adults and kids alike love this cake.
h4-buguan.why: A 还是 B after 不管 is open, and 都 gives the same result.

h4-buguan.en: Whether or not it rains tomorrow, I'm going.
h4-buguan.why: 不管 goes right before the open question 下不下雨.

h4-buguo.ch: 这个菜很好吃，__有点儿辣。
h4-buguo.en: This dish is tasty, though it's a bit spicy.
h4-buguo.why: 不过 is a gentle "though" that adds a small reservation.

h4-buguo.ch: 别紧张，我只__是随便问问。
h4-buguo.en: Don't be nervous — I'm only asking.
h4-buguo.why: 只不过 means "it's only"; 可是 and 但是 can't follow 只.

h4-buguo.en: He was only trying to help you.
h4-buguo.why: 只不过 goes before the verb and means "it's only".

h4-buguo.ch: 这家饭店不过很有名，菜很贵。
h4-buguo.fix: 这家饭店很有名，不过菜很贵。
h4-buguo.en: This restaurant is famous, though the food is expensive.
h4-buguo.why: 不过 opens the second part — the reservation.

h4-buguo.ch: 我很想去，不过今天真的没有时间。
h4-buguo.en: I'd love to go, but I really don't have time today.
h4-buguo.why: 不过 softly adds the drawback after the first statement.

h4-bujin-erqie.ch: 他不仅会做菜，__做得特别好吃。
h4-bujin-erqie.en: He doesn't just cook — his food is really delicious too.
h4-bujin-erqie.why: 不仅 pairs with 而且 to add a further point.

h4-bujin-erqie.en: He's not only my teacher, he's my friend too.
h4-bujin-erqie.why: With one subject, the subject comes before 不仅; 也 follows in the second part.

h4-bujin-erqie.ch: 不仅她会弹钢琴，而且会唱歌。
h4-bujin-erqie.fix: 她不仅会弹钢琴，而且会唱歌。
h4-bujin-erqie.en: She can not only play the piano but also sing.
h4-bujin-erqie.why: With one subject, put it before 不仅.

h4-bujin-erqie.ch: 不仅学生喜欢这位老师，别的老师也喜欢她。
h4-bujin-erqie.en: It's not just the students who like her — the other teachers do too.
h4-bujin-erqie.why: With two different subjects, 不仅 comes first.

h4-bujin-erqie.en: This place has beautiful scenery, and it's easy to get around too.
h4-bujin-erqie.why: 不仅 goes after the topic, before the first point; 而且 opens the second.

h4-chabuduo.ch: 我们两个人的个子__，都是一米七。
h4-chabuduo.en: We're about the same height — both 1.7 metres.
h4-chabuduo.why: As the main word, 差不多 means "much the same"; 大概 and 左右 need a number.

h4-chabuduo.en: He speaks Chinese almost like a native.
h4-chabuduo.why: A 跟 B 差不多 says A and B are much the same.

h4-chabuduo.ch: 我等了你半个小时差不多。
h4-chabuduo.fix: 我等了你差不多半个小时。
h4-chabuduo.en: I waited for you for nearly half an hour.
h4-chabuduo.why: 差不多 goes before the amount; only 左右 goes after.

h4-chabuduo.ch: 作业差不多写完了，我再检查一下。
h4-chabuduo.en: My homework's nearly done — I'll just check it over.
h4-chabuduo.why: 差不多 before a verb means "nearly".

parts: 别人经常叫错我们的名字。
h4-chabuduo.en: My sister and I look so alike that people often mix up our names.
h4-chabuduo.why: Here 差不多 is the main word after 长得: "much the same".

h4-chuci-yiwai.ch: 我每天要上课、做作业，__，还要去饭店工作。
h4-chuci-yiwai.en: Every day I have classes and homework, and on top of that I work in a restaurant.
h4-chuci-yiwai.why: 除此以外 points back to what you've just said; 除了 needs the thing named after it.

h4-chuci-yiwai.en: He plays the piano, and he can sing and dance as well.
h4-chuci-yiwai.why: 除此以外 opens a new clause, and 还 adds one more thing.

h4-chuci-yiwai.ch: 除此以外我妹妹，家里没有人会做菜。
h4-chuci-yiwai.fix: 除了我妹妹以外，家里没有人会做菜。
h4-chuci-yiwai.en: Apart from my sister, nobody at home can cook.
h4-chuci-yiwai.why: 此 already means "this"; to name the thing, use 除了……以外.

h4-chuci-yiwai.ch: 这件衣服颜色不太好，除此以外，我都很满意。
h4-chuci-yiwai.en: The colour of this top isn't great, but apart from that I'm happy with it.
h4-chuci-yiwai.why: With 都, 除此以外 means there's nothing else to add.

h4-chuci-yiwai.en: I only brought my passport — nothing else.
h4-chuci-yiwai.why: 除此以外 comes after the comma and points back to the passport.

h4-chulai.ch: 我想了很久，终于想__一个好办法。
h4-chulai.en: I thought for ages and finally came up with a good idea.
h4-chulai.why: 想出来 means thinking up something new; 想起来 is remembering.

h4-chulai.en: Who came up with this dish?
h4-chulai.why: 做出来 shows something new was made.

h4-chulai.ch: 我想出来了，他是我以前的同学！
h4-chulai.fix: 我想起来了，他是我以前的同学！
h4-chulai.en: I remember now — he's an old classmate of mine!
h4-chulai.why: Remembering someone you already knew is 想起来; 想出来 is thinking up something new.

h4-chulai.ch: 这个题太难了，我想了一个晚上也没有想出来。
h4-chulai.en: This question was too hard — I thought all evening and couldn't work it out.
h4-chulai.why: 想出来 means working out an answer you didn't have before.

h4-chulai.en: Did you come up with this great idea?
h4-chulai.why: 想出来 means thinking up something new; 出来 goes right after the verb.

h4-conglai.en: I've never been to that place.
h4-conglai.why: For "has never once" with 过, use 从来没有, not 从来不.

h4-conglai.en: My grandma has never used a computer.
h4-conglai.why: 从来 + 没有 + verb + 过 means "has never once".

h4-conglai.ch: 我从来不吃过这种水果。
h4-conglai.fix: 我从来没有吃过这种水果。
h4-conglai.en: I've never had this kind of fruit.
h4-conglai.why: With 过 (experience), use 没有, not 不.

h4-conglai.ch: 他从来不在上课的时候玩手机。
h4-conglai.en: He never plays on his phone in class.
h4-conglai.why: 从来不 is a habit he keeps.

h4-conglai.en: I've never told him about this.
h4-conglai.why: 从来 goes right before 没有.

h4-dagai.en: This top costs about two hundred yuan.
h4-dagai.why: 大概 goes before the number; 左右 would go after it.

h4-dagai.en: This book has about three hundred pages.
h4-dagai.why: 大概 goes before the verb and the number.

h4-dagai.ch: 我们等了二十分钟大概。
h4-dagai.fix: 我们大概等了二十分钟。
h4-dagai.why: 大概 goes before the verb or number, never at the end.

h4-dagai.ch: 他一直不回短信，大概已经睡觉了。
h4-dagai.en: He hasn't replied to my texts — he's probably gone to bed.
h4-dagai.why: Before a verb, 大概 is a guess: "probably".

h4-dagai.en: He's probably at the airport by now.
h4-dagai.why: 大概 goes after the subject, at the front of the guess.

h4-dao.ch: 这家饭店不大，客人__挺多的。
h4-dao.en: The restaurant isn't big, but it actually has quite a lot of customers.
h4-dao.why: 倒 (dào) marks something you wouldn't expect; 到 sounds the same but is a different word.

h4-dao.en: This top isn't expensive — it's just that the colour isn't nice.
h4-dao.why: 倒是 grants one good point, then 就是 gives the drawback.

h4-dao.ch: 我们都很累，倒他一点儿也不累。
h4-dao.fix: 我们都很累，他倒一点儿也不累。
h4-dao.en: We're all tired, but he isn't tired at all.
h4-dao.why: 倒 goes after the subject, before the part you wouldn't expect.

h4-dao.ch: 你说得倒轻松，你来做做看！
h4-dao.en: That's easy for you to say — you try doing it!
h4-dao.why: 说得倒 + adjective means "that's easy for you to say".

h4-dao.en: It's cheap, but the quality is actually good.
h4-dao.why: 倒 sits after the subject 质量, right before the adjective.

h4-daodi.ch: 你__喜欢不喜欢这个工作？
h4-daodi.en: Do you actually like this job or not?
h4-daodi.why: 到底 pushes for a real answer and goes with A 不 A.

h4-daodi.en: What on earth do you want me to do?
h4-daodi.why: 到底 goes before the verb, and the question uses a question word.
到底 doesn't go with 吗; use A 不 A or a question word.

h4-daodi.ch: 他到底是新来的，很多事情还不清楚。
h4-daodi.en: He's new here, after all — there's a lot he doesn't know yet.
h4-daodi.why: In a statement, 到底是 means "after all".

h4-daodi.en: Where on earth do you want to go?
h4-daodi.why: 到底 goes after the subject, before the verb.

h4-dui-laishuo.ch: 对老人__，上网买东西不太方便。
h4-dui-laishuo.en: For old people, shopping online isn't very convenient.
h4-dui-laishuo.why: 对 + person + 来说 gives a point of view; 对……说 means "say to".

h4-dui-laishuo.en: For my dad, going online on a phone is hard.
h4-dui-laishuo.why: 对 + person + 来说 opens the sentence with whose view it is.

h4-dui-laishuo.ch: 对我说，每天六点起床太难了。
h4-dui-laishuo.fix: 对我来说，每天六点起床太难了。
h4-dui-laishuo.en: For me, getting up at six every day is too hard.
h4-dui-laishuo.why: 对我说 means "said to me"; for a point of view you need 来说.

h4-dui-laishuo.ch: 他对我说：“别担心，我来帮助你。”
h4-dui-laishuo.en: He said to me, "Don't worry, I'll help you."
h4-dui-laishuo.why: Here he really said something to me, so plain 对我说 is right.

h4-dui-laishuo.en: For many young people, a phone matters more than a TV.
h4-dui-laishuo.why: 来说 closes the frame: 对 + person + 来说.

h4-duiyu.en: She smiled and said to me, "Thank you!"
h4-duiyu.why: Speaking to a person takes 对; 对于 is only for topics.

h4-duiyu.en: As for his suggestion, I completely agree.
h4-duiyu.why: 对于 + topic opens the sentence; the view comes after.

h4-duiyu.en: Our teacher is very good to us.
h4-duiyu.why: Treating someone well takes 对; 对于 can't do that.

h4-duiyu.ch: 对于这次考试的结果，他不太满意。
h4-duiyu.en: He isn't very happy with the exam results.
h4-duiyu.why: 对于 brings in the topic — the results.

h4-duiyu.en: The school takes students' views very seriously.
h4-duiyu.why: 对于 + the topic comes before the verb.

h4-er.ch: 大城市很热闹，__小城市很安静。
h4-er.en: Big cities are lively, whereas small towns are quiet.
h4-er.why: 而 sets two contrasting clauses side by side; 和 only joins nouns.

h4-er.en: He's here to work, not to play.

h4-er.why: 而 joins clauses, never two nouns; use 和.

h4-er.ch: 姐姐做事情很仔细，而妹妹总是很马虎。
h4-er.en: The older sister is careful, while the younger one is always careless.
h4-er.why: 而 shows how the two sisters differ.

h4-er.en: My room is big, whereas his is small.
h4-er.why: 而 opens the second clause that contrasts with the first.

h4-fouze.ch: 你最好十点以前睡觉，__明天会起不来。
h4-fouze.en: You'd better go to bed before ten, or you won't be able to get up tomorrow.
h4-fouze.why: 否则 means "if not" and brings in the bad result.

h4-fouze.en: Put on more clothes, or you'll catch a cold.
h4-fouze.why: The advice comes first, then 否则 + what happens if you don't.

h4-fouze.ch: 如果你不复习，否则考试会很难。
h4-fouze.fix: 你要好好复习，否则考试会很难。
h4-fouze.en: You need to revise properly, or the exam will be hard.
h4-fouze.why: 否则 already means "if not", so don't add 如果.

h4-fouze.ch: 我们得快点儿走，否则就赶不上飞机了。
h4-fouze.en: We have to hurry, or we'll miss the plane.
h4-fouze.why: 否则 brings in what happens if we don't hurry.

h4-fouze.en: You'd better buy tickets in advance, or you won't be able to get any.
h4-fouze.why: 否则 starts the second part, after the advice.

h4-gan.en: My little sister is scared to sleep alone at night.

h4-gan-2.en: Why didn't you give me a call?

h4-gan-2.en: What have you been up to lately?
h4-gan-2.why: In speech 干 often replaces 做: 干什么.

h4-gan-2.en: He's doing his homework in his room.
h4-gan-2.why: Set pairs like 做作业 keep 做.

h4-gan-2.ch: 这个月你干得很好，经理很满意。
h4-gan-2.en: You did a great job this month — the manager's very happy.
h4-gan-2.why: 干得很好 is quick praise for a job done.

h4-gan-2.en: What are you planning to do tonight?
h4-gan-2.why: 干 is the casual "do", right before 什么.

h4-gang.ch: 我__坐下，经理就叫我过去。
h4-gang.en: I'd only just sat down when the manager called me over.
h4-gang.why: 刚 pairs with 就 for "no sooner … than"; 刚才 can't.

h4-gang.en: The film had only just started when he left.
h4-gang.why: 刚 A，就 B: B happens straight after A.

h4-gang.ch: 我刚才进门，手机就响了。
h4-gang.en: I'd only just come in when my phone rang.
h4-gang.why: Only 刚, not 刚才, pairs with 就 this way.

h4-gang.ch: 我带的钱刚够买一个面包。
h4-gang.en: The money I had on me was just enough for a bread roll.
h4-gang.why: 刚 + 够 means "only just enough".

h4-gang.en: It's only just eight — no need to hurry.
h4-gang.why: 刚 goes before the amount, meaning "only just".

h4-gou.ch: 我们带的水不__，得再买一些。
h4-gou.en: We didn't bring enough water — we need to buy some more.
h4-gou.why: 够 is a verb: the thing comes first, then (不) 够.

h4-gou.en: I don't have enough time to read.
h4-gou.why: 够 is a verb: the thing comes first, then 够.

h4-gou.ch: 今天我玩够了，明天要好好学习。
h4-gou.en: I've had enough fun today — tomorrow I'll study hard.
h4-gou.why: Verb + 够 + 了 means you've had your fill.

h4-gou.en: This money isn't enough to buy a computer.
h4-gou.why: 够 comes after 不 and before what you want to do with it.

h4-guji.ch: 天很黑，__一会儿要下雨了。
h4-guji.en: It's very dark — I reckon it's going to rain soon.
h4-guji.why: 估计 is a guess from what you can see; 计划 and 打算 are plans.

h4-guji.en: I reckon he won't come today.
h4-guji.why: 估计 comes before the guess.
估计 is a guess; don't pair it with 肯定 (for sure).

h4-guji.ch: 这些菜估计够五个人吃。
h4-guji.en: I reckon this food is enough for five people.
h4-guji.why: 估计 gives a reasoned guess about an amount.

h4-guji.en: Judging by his face, I reckon he passed the exam.
h4-guji.why: 估计 comes after 我, before the guess.

h4-jieguo.ch: 他说一定会来，__一直没有来。
h4-jieguo.en: He said he'd definitely come, but in the end he never showed up.
h4-jieguo.why: 结果 tells how things actually turned out.

h4-jieguo.en: We rushed to the airport, but the plane had already taken off.
h4-jieguo.why: 结果 opens the clause that tells how things turned out.

h4-jieguo.ch: 新闻说明天会下雨，结果我们明天不去了。
h4-jieguo.fix: 新闻说明天会下雨，所以我们明天不去了。
h4-jieguo.en: The news says it'll rain tomorrow, so we're not going.
h4-jieguo.why: 结果 only tells how things turned out; a plan for tomorrow takes 所以.

h4-jieguo.ch: 他每天都认真练习，结果比赛拿了第一。
h4-jieguo.en: He practised hard every day, and ended up winning the competition.
h4-jieguo.why: 结果 brings in the outcome of what came before.

h4-jieguo.en: I asked him to go and buy the tickets, and he completely forgot.
h4-jieguo.why: 结果 opens the second part — how it turned out.

h4-jiezhe.ch: 我还没有说完呢，让我__说。
h4-jiezhe.en: I haven't finished — let me carry on.
h4-jiezhe.why: 接着 means carrying on from where you stopped.

h4-jiezhe.en: He rested for a moment and then went straight back to work.
h4-jiezhe.why: 接着 means straight after that, with no gap.

h4-jiezhe.ch: 他说了一半就停了，过了一会儿又然后说。
h4-jiezhe.fix: 他说了一半就停了，过了一会儿又接着说。
h4-jiezhe.en: He stopped halfway, then after a moment carried on.
h4-jiezhe.why: 然后 only gives the order; picking up where you stopped takes 接着.

h4-jiezhe.ch: 她洗完衣服，接着又打扫了房间。
h4-jiezhe.en: She finished the washing and went straight on to clean the room.
h4-jiezhe.why: 接着 shows the second job followed straight on.

h4-jiezhe.en: I'll carry on today with the book I didn't finish yesterday.
h4-jiezhe.why: 接着 goes right before the verb it continues.

h4-jingran.ch: 这个题很简单，他__做错了。
h4-jingran.en: This question was easy, and he actually got it wrong!
h4-jingran.why: 竟然 shows it wasn't what you expected; 突然 is only about suddenness.

h4-jingran.en: A five-year-old can actually speak three languages!
h4-jingran.why: 竟然 goes after the subject, before the verb.

h4-jingran.ch: 竟然她一次就通过了考试。
h4-jingran.fix: 她竟然一次就通过了考试。
h4-jingran.en: She actually passed the exam on her first try!
h4-jingran.why: 竟然 goes after the subject.

h4-jingran.ch: 我等了他两个小时，他竟然说忘记了。
h4-jingran.en: I waited two hours for him, and he actually said he forgot!
h4-jingran.why: 竟然 carries surprise and annoyance.

h4-jingran.en: It was freezing, and he was wearing just a shirt!
h4-jingran.why: 竟然 goes after the subject 他, before the verb.

h4-jinguan.ch: __他很努力，还是没有通过考试。
h4-jinguan.en: Even though he worked hard, he still didn't pass the exam.
h4-jinguan.why: 尽管 + a fact; 不管 needs an open question, and 即使 is for what might happen.

h4-jinguan.en: Even though he wasn't feeling well, he still went to work.
h4-jinguan.why: 尽管 + a fact, then 还是 in the second half.

h4-jinguan.ch: 尽管你去不去，我都要去。
h4-jinguan.fix: 不管你去不去，我都要去。
h4-jinguan.en: I'm going whether you go or not.
h4-jinguan.why: An open question like 去不去 takes 不管, not 尽管.

h4-jinguan.ch: 尽管已经十二点了，他还在工作。
h4-jinguan.en: Even though it's already midnight, he's still working.
h4-jinguan.why: 尽管 + a fact that's true; the work goes on anyway.

h4-jinguan.en: If you need help, just give me a call.
h4-jinguan.why: 尽管 + verb means "feel free to"; it goes right before the verb phrase.

h4-jinxing.ch: 警察正在对这件事情__调查。
h4-jinxing.en: The police are investigating the matter.
h4-jinxing.why: 进行 + a two-syllable action word means formally carrying it out.
进行 is followed by a two-syllable action word, here 讨论.

h4-jinxing.ch: 医生进行检查了他的身体。
h4-jinxing.fix: 医生对他的身体进行了检查。
h4-jinxing.en: The doctor gave him a check-up.
h4-jinxing.why: The thing being dealt with moves in front with 对; nothing follows 检查.

h4-jinxing.ch: 会议正在进行，请不要打电话。
h4-jinxing.en: The meeting is under way — please don't make phone calls.
h4-jinxing.why: 正在进行 on its own means "under way".
进行 comes after the 对 phrase, before 了 + the action word.

h4-jiran.ch: __你已经决定了，我就不说什么了。
h4-jiran.en: Since you've already decided, I won't say anything more.
h4-jiran.why: 既然 starts from a known fact, and 就 draws the conclusion.

h4-jiran.en: Since you like it so much, just buy it.
h4-jiran.why: 既然 + known fact, then 就 + suggestion.

h4-jiran.ch: 既然你累了，所以去休息吧。
h4-jiran.fix: 既然你累了，就去休息吧。
h4-jiran.en: Since you're tired, go and rest.
h4-jiran.why: 既然 pairs with 就, not 所以.

h4-jiran.ch: 既然已经同意了，就一定要做到。
h4-jiran.en: Now that you've agreed, you have to follow through.
h4-jiran.why: 既然 gives the known fact; 就 gives the sensible next step.

h4-jiran.en: If you don't want to go, then don't.
h4-jiran.why: 既然 goes before the known fact; with one subject it can follow 你.

h4-jishi-ye.en: Even if you don't agree, I'm still going.
h4-jishi-ye.why: 即使 pairs with 也, not 就.

h4-jishi-ye.en: Even if nobody helps me, I can get it done.
h4-jishi-ye.why: 即使 + condition, then subject + 也 + result.

h4-jishi-ye.ch: 即使昨天下雨了，我们还是去爬山了。
h4-jishi-ye.fix: 虽然昨天下雨了，我们还是去爬山了。
h4-jishi-ye.en: Although it rained yesterday, we still went hiking.
h4-jishi-ye.why: Yesterday's rain is already a fact, so it takes 虽然; 即使 is for what might happen.

h4-jishi-ye.ch: 即使只有一个学生来，我也要把课上完。
h4-jishi-ye.en: Even if only one student turns up, I'll still teach the whole class.
h4-jishi-ye.why: 即使 gives an extreme case; 也 says the result still holds.

h4-jishi-ye.en: However busy you are, remember to rest.
h4-jishi-ye.why: 即使 goes before the condition 再忙, and 也 follows in the second half.

h4-jiujing.why: 究竟 pushes a question hard; 竟然 is for surprise in statements.

h4-jiujing.en: What exactly do you want me to do?
h4-jiujing.why: 究竟 goes before the verb and needs a question word, not 吗.

h4-jiujing.en: Can you actually swim or not?
h4-jiujing.why: 究竟 doesn't take 吗; use A 不 A.

h4-jiujing.ch: 他们两个人，究竟谁说的是真的？
h4-jiujing.en: Of the two of them, who is actually telling the truth?
h4-jiujing.why: 究竟 can go right before a question word like 谁.

h4-jiujing.en: What exactly is the answer to this question?
h4-jiujing.why: 究竟 goes before the verb 是 in the question.

h4-ji-you.en: He can both cook and paint.
h4-ji-you.why: 既 A 又 B means "both … and"; 既然 means "since".

h4-ji-you.en: This room is both clean and quiet.
h4-ji-you.why: 既 pairs with 又 (or 也); 和 can't join here.

h4-ji-you.ch: 这件衣服既漂亮又太贵了。
h4-ji-you.fix: 这件衣服既漂亮又便宜。
h4-ji-you.en: This top is both pretty and cheap.
h4-ji-you.why: Keep both parts pointing the same way — two good points or two bad ones.

h4-ji-you.ch: 走路上班，既省钱，又能锻炼身体。
h4-ji-you.en: Walking to work saves money and keeps you fit too.
h4-ji-you.why: 既 A 又 B links two good points.

h4-ji-you.en: My mum is both a doctor and a writer.
h4-ji-you.why: 既 goes after the subject, before the first part.

h4-ke.ch: 你__别告诉他，他会生气的。
h4-ke.en: Whatever you do, don't tell him — he'll be angry.
h4-ke.why: 可 before 别 makes the warning stronger.
可 + adjective + 了 adds strong feeling.
In an exclamation, 可 + adjective needs 了 at the end.

h4-ke.en: You really must look after yourself!
h4-ke.why: 可 + 要 makes the advice stronger.

h4-ke.en: The food he cooks is really delicious!
h4-ke.why: 可 goes right before the adjective, with 了 at the end.

h4-kebushi.ch: “最近天气真好。”“可不__吗，天天都是晴天。”
h4-kebushi.en: "The weather's been great lately." "Hasn't it just — sunny every day."
h4-kebushi.why: The set reply is 可不是（吗）.

h4-kebushi.ch: “这儿的菜太辣了。”“__，我都吃不下了。”
h4-kebushi.en: "The food here is too spicy." "Tell me about it — I can't eat any more."
h4-kebushi.why: 可不是 agrees strongly; 不是 would say "no".

h4-kebushi.en: Tell me about it — I think it's expensive too.
h4-kebushi.why: 可不是吗 opens the reply, then you add more.

h4-kebushi.ch: “你是学生吗？”“可不是，我已经工作了。”
h4-kebushi.fix: “你是学生吗？”“不是，我已经工作了。”
h4-kebushi.en: "Are you a student?" "No, I'm already working."
h4-kebushi.why: 可不是 means "exactly" — it can't say no.

h4-kebushi.ch: “这个考试太难了。”“可不是吗，很多题我都不会。”
h4-kebushi.en: "This exam was so hard." "You're telling me — I couldn't do lots of the questions."
h4-kebushi.why: 可不是吗 agrees and adds a detail.

h4-kending.ch: 他平时从来不迟到，今天没有来，__是生病了。
h4-kending.en: He's never usually late — he didn't come today, so he must be ill.
h4-kending.why: 肯定 says you're sure about what must be true.

h4-kending.en: I definitely won't tell anyone about this.
h4-kending.why: For "definitely not", 不 goes after 肯定.

h4-kending.ch: 今天下雨，他不肯定去公园了。
h4-kending.fix: 今天下雨，他肯定不去公园了。
h4-kending.en: It's raining today, so he definitely won't go to the park.
h4-kending.why: 不肯定 means "not sure"; "definitely not" is 肯定不.

h4-kending.ch: 我很肯定，那天我把钥匙放在桌子上了。
h4-kending.en: I'm sure I put the keys on the table that day.
h4-kending.why: 肯定 can be an adjective: 很肯定 = quite sure.

h4-kending.en: It's eleven now — the shops must be shut already.
h4-kending.why: 肯定 goes after the subject, before the rest of the sentence.

h4-keshi.en: I called him, but he never picked up.
h4-keshi.why: 可是 means "but" and starts the second clause.

h4-keshi.en: Although it was tiring, everyone was happy.

h4-keshi.ch: 可是很好吃，这个菜有点儿辣。

h4-keshi.why: 可是 starts the second clause, not the first.

h4-keshi.ch: 我本来想去，可是突然有事情，去不了了。
h4-keshi.en: I was going to go, but something suddenly came up and now I can't.
h4-keshi.why: 可是 brings in the contrast.

h4-keshi.en: He's studied Chinese for three years, but he still doesn't speak it very well.
h4-keshi.why: 可是 starts the second clause, right after the comma.

h4-kongpa.ch: 路上堵车，我们__赶不上飞机了。
h4-kongpa.en: The traffic's bad — I'm afraid we'll miss the plane.
h4-kongpa.why: 恐怕 softens an unwelcome guess; 害怕 is real fear.

h4-kongpa.en: I've been scared of dogs since I was little.
h4-kongpa.why: Being scared of a thing takes 害怕; 恐怕 is only a guess.

h4-kongpa.en: I'm scared of being home alone.
h4-kongpa.why: 恐怕 isn't about fear; for being scared, use 害怕.

h4-kongpa.en: It's very cloudy — I'm afraid it's going to rain.
h4-kongpa.why: 恐怕 gives a worried guess.

h4-kongpa.en: I'm afraid we're going to be late.
h4-kongpa.why: 恐怕 goes before the guess — here, after the subject.

h4-lai.ch: 这些东西太重了，让我__吧。
h4-lai.en: These things are too heavy — let me do it.
h4-lai.why: 来 can stand in for the real verb: "let me take care of it".

h4-lai.en: Excuse me, two buns for us, please.
You sit down — I'll do it.
h4-lai.why: 来 already stands for the job; no need for 它.
来 + verb shows you're stepping in to do it.

h4-lai.en: Don't worry, everyone — I'll find a way.
h4-lai.why: 来 goes after the person, before the job they take on.

h4-laibuji.ch: 电影七点开始，现在六点五十，我们还在家里，__了。
h4-laibuji.en: The film starts at seven, it's ten to seven, and we're still at home — we won't make it.
h4-laibuji.why: 来不及 says there's no time left; the 不 goes in the middle.

h4-laibuji.en: Even if you set off at ten, you'll still make it.
h4-laibuji.why: 来得及 says there's still time.

h4-laibuji.ch: 我不来得及跟他说再见。
h4-laibuji.en: I didn't have time to say goodbye to him.
h4-laibuji.why: The 不 goes in the middle: 来不及.

h4-laibuji.ch: 今天我八点才起床，来不及洗脸就出门了。
h4-laibuji.en: I didn't get up till eight today, so I went out without time to wash my face.
h4-laibuji.why: 来不及 + the action you had no time for.

h4-laibuji.en: Hurry up — the plane's about to take off, we'll be too late!
h4-laibuji.why: 来不及 can end the sentence: 要来不及了.

h4-lian.en: He's so busy he even works at weekends.
h4-lian.why: 连 X always needs 都 or 也 after it.

h4-lian.en: He left without even having a drink of water.

h4-lian.ch: 这个字太简单了，连小孩子认识。

h4-lian.ch: 我太累了，连电视也不想看。
h4-lian.en: I'm so tired I don't even want to watch TV.
h4-lian.why: 连 + X + 也 works just like 连……都.

h4-lian.en: I'm so tired I don't even want to look at my phone.
h4-lian.why: 连 goes right before X, the thing you'd least expect.

h4-liheci-chongdie.ch: 累了的时候，我喜欢__，听听音乐。
h4-liheci-chongdie.en: When I'm tired, I like to go online for a bit and listen to some music.

h4-liheci-chongdie.en: Let's go downstairs for a little walk.
h4-liheci-chongdie.why: 散步 doubles as 散散步 and goes where the verb goes.

h4-liheci-chongdie.ch: 你累了就去洗澡洗澡吧。
h4-liheci-chongdie.en: If you're tired, go and have a quick bath.

h4-liheci-chongdie.ch: 每天下班回家，他都先洗洗澡，再看看电视。
h4-liheci-chongdie.en: Every day when he gets home from work, he has a quick shower and then watches a bit of TV.
h4-liheci-chongdie.why: 洗洗澡 doubles only 洗; 看看 doubles a plain verb.

h4-liheci-chongdie.en: The weather's lovely today — let's go out for a little walk.
h4-liheci-chongdie.why: The doubled split verb 散散步 goes where the verb goes, after 出去.

h4-lingwai.ch: 这两个菜不够吃，我们__再点一个吧。
h4-lingwai.en: These two dishes aren't enough — let's order another one.
h4-lingwai.why: Before a verb, 另外 goes with 再; 别的 and 其他 go before nouns.

h4-lingwai.ch: 这五本书我只看过一本，__四本都没有看过。
h4-lingwai.en: Of these five books I've only read one — I haven't read the other four.
h4-lingwai.why: With a number, use 另外, not 别的.

h4-lingwai.en: We set off at eight tomorrow. Also, don't forget to bring water.
h4-lingwai.why: At the start of a sentence, 另外 adds one more point.
With a number, use 另外; 别的 can't take one.

h4-lingwai.ch: 这件事情我们另外找时间再讨论吧。
h4-lingwai.en: Let's find another time to discuss this.
h4-lingwai.why: Before a verb, 另外 goes with 再.

h4-mingliangci-chongdie.ch: 看着一__老照片，他想起了很多过去的事情。
h4-mingliangci-chongdie.en: Looking at old photo after old photo, he remembered lots of things from the past.
h4-mingliangci-chongdie.why: 一 + a doubled measure word paints many things one after another; photos take 张.

h4-mingliangci-chongdie.en: New book after new book lay on the table.
h4-mingliangci-chongdie.why: 一 + doubled measure + noun: one after another.

h4-mingliangci-chongdie.ch: 看到这个结果，同学们一个都很高兴。
h4-mingliangci-chongdie.fix: 看到这个结果，同学们一个个都很高兴。

h4-mingliangci-chongdie.why: Without the doubled 个, 一个都 sounds like "not even one".

h4-mingliangci-chongdie.ch: 请大家别着急，一个一个地说。
h4-mingliangci-chongdie.en: No rush, everyone — speak one at a time.
h4-mingliangci-chongdie.why: 一个一个地 + verb tells how it's done: one at a time.

h4-mingliangci-chongdie.en: Every single one of them works hard.
h4-mingliangci-chongdie.why: 一 + 个个 goes before 都: every one of them.

h4-ting.en: Your new room is pretty big.
h4-ting.why: 挺 goes before the adjective, with 的 at the end.
不 can't go before 挺; for "not very", use 不太.

h4-ting.en: The coffee here is pretty good.
h4-ting.why: 挺 goes right before the adjective 好喝, with 的 at the end.

h4-tongguo.ch: 我是__报纸上的广告找到这份工作的。
h4-tongguo.en: I found this job through an advert in the paper.
h4-tongguo.why: 通过 names the channel that got it done: the advert.
A tool in your hand takes 用; 通过 is for a channel or process.

h4-tongguo.en: She found this job through a friend.
h4-tongguo.why: 通过 + the go-between comes before the verb.
tpy: zhǎo dào zhè fèn gōng zuò de

h4-tongguo.en: He drinks soup with a spoon.
h4-tongguo.why: A spoon is a tool in your hand, so use 用.

h4-tongguo.ch: 通过老师的介绍，我认识了现在的女朋友。
h4-tongguo.en: I met my girlfriend through my teacher introducing us.
h4-tongguo.why: 通过 names the go-between: the teacher's introduction.

h4-tongshi.ch: 这本书很有意思，__也很有用。
h4-tongshi.en: This book is interesting, and useful at the same time.
h4-tongshi.why: At the start of a clause, 同时 (with 也) adds a second fact that is also true.

h4-tongshi.en: The two children burst out laughing at the same time.
h4-tongshi.why: For "at the same moment", 同时 goes after the subject, right before the verb.

h4-tongshi.ch: 我们两个人开了门同时。
h4-tongshi.fix: 我们两个人同时开了门。
h4-tongshi.en: The two of us opened the door at the same time.
h4-tongshi.why: 同时 goes before the verb, not at the end of the sentence.

h4-tongshi.ch: 在工作的同时，她也在学习汉语。
h4-tongshi.en: While working, she's also studying Chinese.
h4-tongshi.why: 在……的同时 means "while also …", and 也 follows in the second half.

h4-tongshi.en: He's my teacher, and at the same time my good friend.
h4-tongshi.why: 同时 opens the second clause and adds another fact, before 也.

h4-wangwang.why: This is a request, so it takes 经常; 往往 only describes a pattern so far.

h4-wangwang.ch: 刚到一个新地方的时候，人们__会觉得不习惯。
h4-wangwang.en: When people first arrive somewhere new, they tend to feel out of place.
h4-wangwang.why: 往往 sums up what usually happens in a certain situation.

h4-wangwang.en: When it rains, the roads tend to get jammed.
h4-wangwang.why: The situation comes first, then 往往 before what usually happens.

h4-wangwang.en: You should come and see us often.
h4-wangwang.why: 往往 can't be used for requests or the future; use 经常.

h4-wangwang.ch: 年轻人往往不太注意自己的身体。
h4-wangwang.en: Young people tend not to look after their health very well.
h4-wangwang.why: 往往 describes a pattern based on experience.

h4-weile-er.ch: 他为了照顾妈妈__回到了老家。
h4-weile-er.en: He moved back to his hometown to look after his mother.
h4-weile-er.why: 为了 + goal + 而 + action: 而 joins the purpose to the action.
为了 + goal comes first, then 而 right before the action.

h4-weile-er.ch: 为了学习汉语，而他来到了中国。
h4-weile-er.fix: 他为了学习汉语而来到了中国。
h4-weile-er.en: He came to China to study Chinese.
h4-weile-er.why: 而 sits right before the action, never before the subject.

h4-weile-er.ch: 很多年轻人为了找到好工作而努力学习。
h4-weile-er.en: Lots of young people study hard in order to find a good job.
h4-weile-er.why: 为了 + goal + 而 + action is the formal "in order to".

h4-weile-er.en: He moved to the city for his child's education.
h4-weile-er.why: 而 goes right after the goal, before the action 搬到了.

h4-wulun.ch: 无论你什么时候来，我__在家。
h4-wulun.en: Whenever you come, I'll be home.
h4-wulun.why: The result after 无论 takes 都 (or 也).

h4-wulun.ch: 无论天气__，比赛都会按时开始。
h4-wulun.en: Whatever the weather, the match will start on time.
h4-wulun.why: 无论 needs an open choice like 怎么样, not a plain statement.

h4-wulun.en: No matter how busy you are, make sure you rest.
h4-wulun.why: 无论 + 多 + adjective comes first, then 都 with the result.

h4-wulun.ch: 无论工作很累，他都很开心。
h4-wulun.fix: 无论工作多累，他都很开心。
h4-wulun.en: However tiring the work is, he's always happy.
h4-wulun.why: 无论 needs an open choice (多, 什么, 还是), not 很.

h4-wulun.en: Whatever he does, he does it carefully.
h4-wulun.why: 无论 goes right before the open choice 做什么.

h4-xiangfan.en: The two of us have completely opposite views.
h4-xiangfan.why: 相反 is also an adjective: opposite.

h4-xiangfan.ch: 这件衣服很漂亮，__太贵了。
h4-xiangfan.en: This top is lovely, but it's too expensive.
h4-xiangfan.why: This is just a contrast, so use 但是; 相反 means the exact opposite.

h4-xiangfan.en: The weather hasn't got any warmer; on the contrary, it's getting colder and colder.
h4-xiangfan.why: 相反 opens the second half and says things went the opposite way.
tpy: yì diǎn r yě méi yǒu

h4-xiangfan.ch: 这家饭店的菜很好吃，相反价格有点儿贵。
h4-xiangfan.fix: 这家饭店的菜很好吃，但是价格有点儿贵。
h4-xiangfan.en: The food at this restaurant is delicious, but it's a bit pricey.
h4-xiangfan.why: This is just a contrast, not the opposite, so use 但是.

h4-xiangfan.ch: 他跟他哥哥的性格正好相反。
h4-xiangfan.en: He and his brother have exactly opposite personalities.
h4-xiangfan.why: A 跟 B + 相反: the two are opposite.

h4-xiang-qilai.ch: 大家一起想，一定能想__一个好办法。
h4-xiang-qilai.en: If we all think together, we're sure to come up with a good idea.
h4-xiang-qilai.why: Thinking up something new is 想出; 想起 is remembering.

h4-xiang-qilai.ch: 我想__来了，他是我以前的同学！
h4-xiang-qilai.en: Now I remember - he's an old classmate of mine!
h4-xiang-qilai.why: A memory coming back is 想起来.

h4-xiang-qilai.en: I can't remember what he's called right now.
h4-xiang-qilai.why: 想不起来 means the memory won't come back.
tpy: tā jiào shén me míng zi

h4-xiang-qilai.ch: 我想出来了，我的手机放在桌子上了。
h4-xiang-qilai.fix: 我想起来了，我的手机放在桌子上了。
h4-xiang-qilai.en: Now I remember - I left my phone on the table.
h4-xiang-qilai.why: Remembering what you knew is 想起来; 想出来 is for new ideas.

h4-xiang-qilai.en: Seeing this dish reminded me of my mum's cooking.
h4-xiang-qilai.why: The thing remembered can go between 想起 and 来.
ppy: wǒ mā ma zuò de cài

h4-yaoshi.en: If only I could speak Chinese.
h4-yaoshi.why: 要是……就好了 is a wish: if only.

h4-yaoshi.ch: 要是你不舒服，你__先回家吧。
h4-yaoshi.en: If you're not feeling well, go home first.
h4-yaoshi.why: After 要是, the result takes 就.

h4-yaoshi.en: If it rains, let's stay in and read.
h4-yaoshi.why: 就 goes after the subject 我们, before the verb.

h4-yaoshi.ch: 要是你有问题，就你问我吧。
h4-yaoshi.fix: 要是你有问题，你就问我吧。
h4-yaoshi.en: If you have a question, just ask me.
h4-yaoshi.why: 就 goes after the subject, never before it.

h4-yaoshi.ch: 要是我有一个大房间就好了。
h4-yaoshi.en: If only I had a big room.
h4-yaoshi.why: 要是……就好了 wishes for something that isn't true.

h4-yi.ch: 她__最快的速度回到了家。
h4-yi.en: She got home as fast as she could.
h4-yi.why: 以 + way or speed + verb is the written "at / by".

h4-yi.ch: 吃面条的时候，我喜欢__筷子。
h4-yi.en: I like to use chopsticks when I eat noodles.
h4-yi.why: Here it's the everyday verb "use", so 用; 以 is written style and can't stand as the verb.

h4-yi.en: We want to buy the best things at the lowest price.
h4-yi.why: 以 + the price comes before the verb.

h4-yi.ch: 你以手机给我打电话吧。
h4-yi.fix: 你用手机给我打电话吧。
h4-yi.why: 以 is written style; for an everyday tool in speech, use 用.

h4-yi.ch: 这个电影以一个女孩子的故事为主要内容。
h4-yi.en: This film is mainly about a girl's story.
h4-yi.why: 以 A 为 B means "take A as B".

h4-yi-jiu.en: Whenever I read, I get sleepy.
h4-yi-jiu.why: 一 needs 就 in the second half: every time A, B.

h4-yi-jiu.en: I'll text you as soon as I get off the plane.
h4-yi-jiu.why: 一 goes before the first action, 就 before the second.

h4-yi-jiu.en: I go to the supermarket as soon as I finish work.
h4-yi-jiu.why: 一 needs 就 in the second half to complete the pattern.

h4-yi-jiu.en: Whenever he gets nervous, he talks fast.
h4-yi-jiu.why: 一 and 就 each come after their own subject.

h4-yi-jiu.en: As soon as it got dark, he went home.
h4-yi-jiu.why: 就 goes after the second subject 他, before the verb.

h4-yinci.ch: 他每天都练习说汉语，__说得越来越好。
h4-yinci.en: He practises speaking Chinese every day, so he's getting better and better.
He didn't come today because he's ill.
h4-yinci.why: This half is the cause, so it takes 因为; 因此 introduces a result.

h4-yinci.ch: 因此天气不好，比赛推迟了。
h4-yinci.fix: 天气不好，因此比赛推迟了。
h4-yinci.en: The weather was bad, so the match was put off.
h4-yinci.why: 因此 introduces the result, not the cause.

h4-yinci.ch: 这家商店的东西很新鲜，因此每天都有很多顾客。
h4-yinci.en: This shop's food is fresh, so it has lots of customers every day.
h4-yinci.why: Cause first, then 因此 + result.

h4-yinci.en: He never exercises, so his health isn't great.
h4-yinci.why: 因此 starts the result half, after the cause.

h4-yiwei.ch: 我__他三十岁，原来他已经四十多了。
h4-yiwei.en: I thought he was thirty, but it turns out he's over forty.
h4-yiwei.why: You believed something that wasn't true, so it takes 以为.

h4-yiwei.ch: 我__他说得对，我们应该提前出发。
h4-yiwei.en: I think he's right; we should set off early.
h4-yiwei.why: This is an opinion you still hold, so use 认为; 以为 hints you were wrong.

h4-yiwei.en: I thought I didn't have to work today!
h4-yiwei.why: 还以为……呢 shows surprise that what you believed was wrong.
tpy: jīn tiān bú yòng shàng bān

h4-yiwei.ch: 我以为学习汉语很重要，你觉得呢？
h4-yiwei.fix: 我认为学习汉语很重要，你觉得呢？
h4-yiwei.en: I think learning Chinese is important. What do you think?
h4-yiwei.why: This is an opinion you hold, so use 认为; 以为 means you were wrong.

h4-yiwei.ch: 我以为他在开玩笑，其实他是认真的。
h4-yiwei.en: I thought he was joking, but he was actually serious.
h4-yiwei.why: 以为 gives the wrong belief; 其实 gives the truth.

h4-yiwen-daici-renzhi.en: We'll go wherever you want to go.
h4-yiwen-daici-renzhi.why: Repeat the same question word in both halves: 哪儿……哪儿 means wherever.

h4-yiwen-daici-renzhi.en: Whoever wants to go can go.
h4-yiwen-daici-renzhi.why: The same question word, 谁, appears in both halves: whoever.
怎么 appears in both halves, with 就 before the second one.

h4-yiwen-daici-renzhi.fix: 你喜欢哪本书就拿哪本。
h4-yiwen-daici-renzhi.why: Repeat the same question word; don't swap in 它.

h4-yiwen-daici-renzhi.en: We'll buy whichever one is cheaper.
h4-yiwen-daici-renzhi.why: The second half takes 就, after the subject and before 买哪个.

h4-you.ch: 这次旅游的事情__他负责。
h4-you.en: He's in charge of this trip.
h4-you.why: Task + 由 + person + verb says who's in charge.

h4-you.en: My wallet was taken by someone.
h4-you.why: Something bad done to you takes 被; 由 only assigns a job.
For who takes care of it, use 由; 被 is for something done to you.

h4-you.ch: 孩子的学习一般由妈妈负责。
h4-you.en: Usually it's the mother who looks after the children's schoolwork.
h4-you.why: The task comes first, and 由 hands it to the person in charge.

h4-you.en: Leave buying the tickets to me.
h4-you.why: 由 goes right before the person who takes the job.

h4-youqi.ch: 我很喜欢运动，尤其__游泳。
h4-youqi.why: Before a noun or activity, 尤其 needs 是.

h4-youqi.ch: 他们家的孩子都很聪明，__是大儿子。
h4-youqi.en: All the kids in that family are clever, especially the eldest son.
h4-youqi.why: 尤其 picks out the standout case from the group.

h4-youqi.en: The weather here is hot, especially in August.
h4-youqi.why: First the general statement, then 尤其是 + the standout case.

h4-youqi.ch: 大家都很喜欢他，尤其老师。
h4-youqi.fix: 大家都很喜欢他，尤其是老师。
h4-youqi.en: Everyone likes him, especially the teachers.
h4-youqi.why: Before a noun or person, 尤其 needs 是.

h4-youqi.ch: 最近天气很冷，今天尤其冷。
h4-youqi.en: It's been cold lately, and today especially.
h4-youqi.why: Before an adjective, 尤其 goes straight in without 是.

h4-youyu.ch: __路上堵车，会议推迟了半个小时。
h4-youyu.en: Because of the traffic, the meeting was pushed back half an hour.
h4-youyu.why: 由于 opens the sentence with the cause.

h4-youyu.ch: 我们迟到了，__路上出了点儿问题。
h4-youyu.en: We were late because something went wrong on the way.
h4-youyu.why: To give the reason afterwards, say 是因为; 由于 opens the sentence.

h4-youyu.ch: 他没有来上课，由于他感冒了。
h4-youyu.fix: 他没有来上课，是因为他感冒了。
h4-youyu.en: He didn't come to class because he had a cold.
h4-youyu.why: 由于 opens the sentence; to give the reason afterwards, say 是因为.

h4-youyu.ch: 由于下雪，很多航班都推迟了。
h4-youyu.en: Because of the snow, lots of flights were delayed.
h4-youyu.why: 由于 + cause comes first, then the result.

h4-youyu.en: Because of the rain today, the match was put off.
h4-youyu.why: 由于 goes right before the cause 下雨.

h4-yuanlai.ch: 我开门一看，__是我的老朋友。
h4-yuanlai.en: I opened the door and - oh, it was an old friend of mine.
h4-yuanlai.why: 原来 marks the truth you've just found out.

h4-yuanlai.en: Why's the door open? Oh, Mum's back.
h4-yuanlai.why: 原来 goes in front of the fact you've just discovered.
原来 isn't a verb for "I found out"; it goes in front of the discovered fact.

h4-yuanlai.ch: 这是我原来的手机号码，现在已经不用了。
h4-yuanlai.en: This is my old phone number; I don't use it any more.
h4-yuanlai.why: 原来的 + noun means what it was before.

h4-yuanlai.en: I thought he was angry, but it turns out he was just too tired.
h4-yuanlai.why: After 以为, 原来 opens the real answer.
ppy: wǒ hái yǐ wéi tā shēng qì le

h4-yushi.ch: 明天可能下雨，__你带把伞吧。
h4-yushi.en: It might rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
h4-yushi.why: This is advice about the future, so use 所以; 于是 tells what actually happened next.

h4-yushi.ch: 他等了很久也没有等到公共汽车，__走回家了。
h4-yushi.en: He waited ages but no bus came, so he walked home.
h4-yushi.why: 于是 tells what someone did next because of what had happened.

h4-yushi.ch: 你要是累了，于是去睡觉吧。
h4-yushi.fix: 你要是累了，就去睡觉吧。
h4-yushi.en: If you're tired, go to bed.
h4-yushi.why: 于是 can't give advice; after 要是, use 就.

h4-yushi.ch: 她觉得这件衣服太贵了，于是没有买。
h4-yushi.en: She thought the top was too expensive, so she didn't buy it.
h4-yushi.why: 于是 tells what she did next, in a real past event.

h4-yushi.en: That shop was closed, so we went to another one.
h4-yushi.why: 于是 opens the clause that says what happened next.
ppy: nà jiā shāng diàn guān mén le

h4-zai-kanlai.ch: 在很多老人__，孩子越多越好。
h4-zai-kanlai.en: In many older people's view, the more children the better.
h4-zai-kanlai.why: 在 + person + 看来 frames what follows as their opinion.

h4-zai-kanlai.en: As I see it, this price is a bit high.
h4-zai-kanlai.why: 在 + person + 看来 comes first, then the opinion.

h4-zai-kanlai.ch: 在我看来，我觉得这个电影不太好看。
h4-zai-kanlai.fix: 在我看来，这个电影不太好看。
h4-zai-kanlai.en: As I see it, this film isn't very good.
h4-zai-kanlai.why: 在我看来 already means "I think"; don't add 我觉得.

h4-zai-kanlai.ch: 在爸爸妈妈看来，孩子的健康比成绩更重要。
h4-zai-kanlai.en: In parents' eyes, a child's health matters more than their marks.
h4-zai-kanlai.why: 在 + group + 看来 gives that group's point of view.

h4-zai-kanlai.en: To many young people, work isn't just about money.
h4-zai-kanlai.why: 看来 closes the frame, right after the person: 在……看来.
ppy: gōng zuò bù zhǐ shì wèi le qián

h4-zai-shang.ch: 他在工作__遇到了一些问题。
h4-zai-shang.en: He's run into some problems at work.
h4-zai-shang.why: For "in the area of", use 上 after the abstract word, not 里.

h4-zai-shang.en: When it comes to studying, he's always worked hard.
h4-zai-shang.why: 在 + area + 上 comes first, then the comment.
tpy: tā yì zhí hěn nǔ lì

h4-zai-shang.why: For "in the area of", use 上, not 里.

h4-zai-shang.ch: 生活上有什么需要，你就跟我说。
h4-zai-shang.en: If you need anything in your daily life, just tell me.
h4-zai-shang.why: 生活上 means "in daily life"; 在 is optional.

h4-zai-shang.en: He helped me a lot financially.
h4-zai-shang.why: 上 closes the frame after the area: 在经济上.

h4-zaishuo.ch: 今天已经十一点了，__你也累了，明天再去吧。
h4-zaishuo.en: It's already eleven, and besides, you're tired too - let's go tomorrow.
h4-zaishuo.why: 再说 adds one more reason for what you're suggesting.

h4-zaishuo.ch: 这个问题现在先不讨论，下次__吧。
h4-zaishuo.en: Let's not discuss this now; we'll deal with it next time.
h4-zaishuo.why: At the end, 再说 means "let's deal with it later".

h4-zaishuo.en: Don't buy it - it's too expensive, and besides, you've already got one.
h4-zaishuo.why: 再说 opens the extra reason that clinches the decision.
tpy: bié mǎi le tài guì le

h4-zaishuo.ch: 老师，您能再说吗？我没有听清楚。
h4-zaishuo.fix: 老师，您能再说一遍吗？我没有听清楚。
h4-zaishuo.en: Could you say that again, please? I didn't catch it.
h4-zaishuo.why: "Say it again" needs 一遍; bare 再说 reads as "besides" or "later".
fixPy: néng zài shuō yí biàn ma

h4-zaishuo.ch: 这件事情，等你找到工作再说吧。
h4-zaishuo.en: Let's leave that until you've found a job.
h4-zaishuo.why: 等……再说 puts something off till later.

h4-zai-xia.ch: 在大家的帮助__，我很快就适应了新工作。
h4-zai-xia.en: With everyone's help, I soon settled into my new job.
h4-zai-xia.why: 在 + someone's help + 下 names the help behind what happened.

h4-zai-xia.ch: __爸爸妈妈的支持下，他开了一家小商店。
h4-zai-xia.en: With his parents' support, he opened a small shop.
h4-zai-xia.why: The frame is 在……下: 在 opens it, 下 closes it.

h4-zai-xia.en: With his mum's help, he finished his homework.
h4-zai-xia.why: 在 + someone's help + 下 comes first, then what happened.
tpy: tā zuò wán le zuò yè

h4-zai-xia.ch: 在朋友帮助我下，我找到了住的地方。
h4-zai-xia.fix: 在朋友的帮助下，我找到了住的地方。
h4-zai-xia.en: With a friend's help, I found somewhere to live.
h4-zai-xia.why: The middle must be a noun phrase (someone's help), not a clause.

h4-zai-xia.ch: 在大家的支持下，这次活动非常成功。
h4-zai-xia.en: With everyone's support, the event was a great success.
h4-zai-xia.why: 在 + someone's support + 下, with 的 in the middle.

h4-zai-ye.ch: 天气再冷，他__坚持去游泳。
h4-zai-ye.en: However cold it gets, he still keeps going swimming.
h4-zai-ye.why: 再 + adjective in the first half, then 也 + the result that doesn't change.

h4-zai-ye.en: However expensive this top is, I'm buying it.
h4-zai-ye.why: "However …" is 再 + adjective, with 也 in the second half.

h4-zai-ye.en: However far it is, I'm still going.
h4-zai-ye.why: 再 goes right before the adjective; 也 comes after the second subject.

h4-zai-ye.ch: 再这个菜很辣，我也想吃。
h4-zai-ye.en: However spicy this dish is, I still want to eat it.
h4-zai-ye.why: 再 goes right before the adjective, with no 很.

h4-zai-ye.en: However he explains it, I won't believe him.
h4-zai-ye.why: 再 goes right before 怎么: 再怎么 + verb, 也 + result.

h4-zaiyu.ch: 这次失败的原因__我们准备得不够。
h4-zaiyu.en: The reason we failed this time is that we didn't prepare enough.
h4-zaiyu.why: 原因 + 在于 says where the reason lies.

h4-zaiyu.en: The problem is that he never listens to other people's advice.
h4-zaiyu.why: The abstract word 问题 comes first, then 在于 and the heart of it.
tpy: tīng bié ren de yì jiàn

h4-zaiyu.ch: 关键在于是你愿意不愿意。
h4-zaiyu.fix: 关键在于你愿意不愿意。
h4-zaiyu.en: The key is whether you're willing or not.
h4-zaiyu.why: 在于 already works like "is"; don't add 是.

h4-zaiyu.ch: 健康的关键在于好的生活习惯。
h4-zaiyu.en: The key to good health is good habits.
h4-zaiyu.why: 关键 + 在于 says what it all comes down to.

h4-zaiyu.en: The key to learning Chinese is listening and speaking a lot.
h4-zaiyu.why: 在于 comes right after the subject 关键.

h4-zhenghao.en: Hang on a minute, I'm doing the washing.
h4-zhenghao.why: "In the middle of doing" is 正在; 正好 means "just right" or "happen to".
Verb + 得 + 正好 means the timing is just right.

h4-zhenghao.en: This money is just enough for two tickets.
h4-zhenghao.why: 正好 goes before 够 to say the amount is just right.

h4-zhenghao.ch: 他正好看电视，你别打扰他。
h4-zhenghao.fix: 他正在看电视，你别打扰他。
h4-zhenghao.en: He's watching TV; don't disturb him.
h4-zhenghao.why: "In the middle of doing" is 正在, not 正好.

h4-zhenghao.ch: 我去他家的时候，他正好不在。
h4-zhenghao.en: When I went to his place, he happened to be out.
h4-zhenghao.why: 正好 before a verb means "as it happens".

h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.en: The child was playing, and then started crying.
h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.why: After V 着 V 着, the new event takes 就 and 了.

h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.en: We walked on and on, and then we got lost.
h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.why: V 着 V 着 comes first, then 就 + the new event + 了.

h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.en: I kept reading, and then I understood.
h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.why: The new event needs 就 (or 突然) and 了.

h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.ch: 爷爷讲着讲着，自己先笑了起来。
h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.en: Grandpa was telling the story, and then he started laughing himself.
h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.why: V 着 V 着, then the new event with 了.

h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.en: We talked and talked, and before we knew it, it was dark.
h4-v-zhe-v-zhe.why: 就 goes after the new subject 天, before the new event.

h4-zhide.en: This film is well worth seeing.
h4-zhide.why: 值得 + verb says something is worth doing.

h4-zhide.en: It's not worth getting angry with him over so little money.
h4-zhide.why: The negative is 不值得: not worth it.

h4-zhide.en: His experience is worth learning from.
This place is well worth visiting.
h4-zhide.why: 很 goes before 值得, and the verb comes after it.

h4-zhide.ch: 花很多时间学习汉语，我觉得很值得。
h4-zhide.en: I think spending lots of time learning Chinese is well worth it.
h4-zhide.why: 值得 can end the sentence: it's worth it.

h4-zhiyao.ch: 只要多练习，你__能说得很好。
h4-zhiyao.en: As long as you practise a lot, you'll be able to speak well.
h4-zhiyao.why: 只要 pairs with 就; 才 belongs with 只有.

h4-zhiyao.en: Only by studying hard can you pass the exam.
h4-zhiyao.why: 才 in the second half needs 只有: the only way.

h4-zhiyao.en: You can use my computer, as long as you give it back on time.
h4-zhiyao.why: 只要 can come after the main point to add the condition.

h4-zhiyao.en: As long as you like it, you can buy it.
h4-zhiyao.why: 只要 pairs with 就, not 才.

h4-zhiyao.ch: 工作累不累没关系，只要同事好就行。
h4-zhiyao.en: It doesn't matter if the work's tiring, as long as the colleagues are nice.
h4-zhiyao.why: 只要……就行 means "as long as …, it's fine".

h4-zongdelaishuo.ch: 房间有点儿小，价格也不便宜，但是__，住得还挺舒服的。
h4-zongdelaishuo.en: The room's a bit small and not cheap, but all in all it's quite comfortable.
h4-zongdelaishuo.why: After the details, 总的来说 gives the overall view.

h4-zongdelaishuo.ch: __，我给大家介绍一下我们的公司。
h4-zongdelaishuo.en: First of all, let me introduce our company.
h4-zongdelaishuo.why: Opening a list takes 首先; 总的来说 sums up at the end.

h4-zongdelaishuo.en: It was a bit tiring, but overall it was great fun.
h4-zongdelaishuo.why: The detail comes first, then 总的来说 and the overall judgement.
tpy: suī rán yǒu diǎn r lèi

h4-zongdelaishuo.ch: 总的来说，我先说第一个问题。
h4-zongdelaishuo.en: First, I'll talk about the first question.
h4-zongdelaishuo.why: 总的来说 sums up; it can't open a list - use 首先.

h4-zongdelaishuo.en: This phone has a few small problems, but overall it's still very easy to use.
h4-zongdelaishuo.why: 总的来说 comes after the details, before the overall judgement.
ppy: zhè ge shǒu jī yǒu xiē xiǎo wèn tí
hái shi hěn hǎo yòng de

h4-zuoyou.ch: 从这儿到机场要一个小时__。
h4-zuoyou.en: It takes about an hour to get from here to the airport.
h4-zuoyou.why: 左右 goes after any amount, including a length of time.

h4-zuoyou.ch: 五月一号__，出去旅游的人特别多。
h4-zuoyou.en: Around the first of May, lots of people go travelling.
h4-zuoyou.why: Around a point in time like a date is 前后.

h4-zuoyou.en: He works about eight hours a day.
h4-zuoyou.why: 左右 goes right after the amount.

h4-zuoyou.en: This top costs about two hundred yuan.
h4-zuoyou.why: 前后 goes with a point in time, not an amount - use 左右.

h4-zuoyou.ch: 这个孩子看起来十岁上下。
h4-zuoyou.why: 上下 can follow an age.

yiwei-renwei.ch: 我__你不来了，没想到你来了！
yiwei-renwei.en: I thought you weren't coming, and here you are!
yiwei-renwei.why: It turned out wrong, so 以为.

yiwei-renwei.en: The teacher thinks this question is important.
yiwei-renwei.why: An opinion, not a mistake: 认为.

yiwei-renwei.ch: 我还__他是中国人，原来他是日本人。
yiwei-renwei.en: I thought he was Chinese; he turned out to be Japanese.
yiwei-renwei.why: 原来 says the thought was wrong, so 以为.
A view you hold: 认为.

yiwei-renwei.ch: 我认为今天会下雨，结果是晴天。
yiwei-renwei.fix: 我以为今天会下雨，结果是晴天。
yiwei-renwei.en: I thought it would rain today, but it was sunny.
yiwei-renwei.why: It turned out wrong, so 以为.
